chunks: It indicates that there is no zakat on al-maʿlūfah, and it also indicates that as well.

key_terms.الْمَعْلُوفَةَ: fodder-fed livestock, as opposed to freely grazing animals
key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: the obligatory alms-tax due on qualifying wealth or livestock
key_terms.يَدُلُّ: indicates; serves as evidence for a legal conclusion

ai.seo_question: Does this text indicate that there is no zakat on al-maʿlūfah?
ai.summary: This passage states a legal implication concerning zakat, namely that no zakat is due on al-maʿlūfah. It is a brief juristic inference tied to the broader discussion of zakat categories in hadith evidence.
